title: Test Infrastructure Import Stabilization v1
root_cause: Parallel-agent sub-module splits (refactor_large_files.py) created facade files that import from incorrect module names or fail to re-export moved symbols. Four patterns found: (1) _error instead of _errors (missing 's'), (2) self-referencing circular imports in facade modules, (3) _models instead of _agent_models, (4) missing re-exports from sub-modules after split.

fixes_applied.change: Fixed 3 instances of 'from _error import' → 'from _errors import', fixed self-referencing 'from _helpers import' → 'from _agent_helpers import', fixed 3 instances of 'from _models import' → 'from _agent_models import'
Added re-export of execute_desktop_intent from _intents/_refinement.py (10+ tests unblocked)

compatibility_decision: Minimal compatibility patches only. All fixes are import-path corrections or alias additions — no behavior changes, no new function implementations. The _error.py (6-line stub without 's') and _models.py (8-line stub without class definitions) are dead files from the parallel split — not deleted per dirty-file preservation policy.
remaining_errors: desktop/ — PROTECTED_INTENTS not defined (used in _refinement.py and _queue.py but never defined), remaining test_intents errors
desktop/ — remaining execute_desktop_intent tests (some files may need additional re-exports from _intents/_queue.py)
context/ — _map_selections_to_recommendations not defined (similar to _map_omissions, needs alias)
tools/test_session_lifecycle_finalize.py — depends on removed lifecycle functions
cli_governance_regression: Not run — CLI governance tests were already 59/59 passing and are not affected by these core import fixes
pyright: Not run on touched files — LSP errors include pre-existing gaps (PROTECTED_INTENTS undefined, execute_desktop_intent re-exports partial)
remaining_seams: PROTECTED_INTENTS dict missing from desktop/_intents/ — needs reconstruction
